name: Snapshot-range editable text layout iteration

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
# Hypothesis

Iterating unprojected `TextBufferSnapshot` logical-line ranges directly removes the whole
`Rope::to_string()` materialization and the temporary logical-line vector. Projected display text
continues to use its already-owned projection string, but also streams `split('\n')` instead of
collecting rows first.

## Scope lock

This experiment changes snapshot line-range access and layout-map line iteration only. It does not
attempt retained-row splicing, cache invalidation, row indexes, or paint behavior.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
# Measurement plan

Run the focused headed WASM/WebGPU TextArea fixture at both DPRs, inspect the screenshot, and
record the action timing. Source inspection must prove the unprojected branch reaches the shaper
without `snapshot.text()` or a logical-line vector, while the projection branch preserves display
to buffer mapping.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
# Expected outcome

The TextArea remains visually and interactively unchanged. Each source logical line is sliced by
its validated Rope range, and the only line-wide allocation is the text retained by its layout row.

measurements.target: headed WASM WebGPU TextArea wheel action
measurements.protocol: One page-isolated 35-run Playwright process per DPR with five warmups and thirty measured samples.

reportMarkdown:
# Snapshot-range editable text layout iteration

All 70 focused headed WASM/WebGPU samples passed with no diagnostics failures and visible,
nonzero TextArea scroll pixels. Unprojected layout preparation no longer materializes the full Rope
or creates a logical-line vector; it slices validated source line ranges one at a time. Projected
text streams its already-owned display string without a line vector.

| DPR | Baseline p50/p95 | After p50/p95 | Reduction p50/p95 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 534.002 / 593.299 ms | 129.493 / 141.935 ms | 75.8% / 76.1% |
| 2 | 497.957 / 561.084 ms | 137.290 / 143.619 ms | 72.4% / 74.4% |

The result is accepted. DPR 2 remains narrowly above the epic p50 target, so the next atomic
experiment must address a measured residual without weakening fixtures or thresholds.
decisionMarkdown:
# Decision

Accept snapshot-range layout iteration. It eliminates the dominant whole-document allocation path
and produces a material, stable WASM improvement while preserving visible TextArea behavior.
